title: Assam silk
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Assam silk is famous for three types: muga (golden silk, unique to Assam), eri (warm, soft “peace silk”, harvested without killing the silkworm) and pat (white mulberry silk).

Muga silk

Muga silk, from the Antheraea assamensis silkworm, has a natural golden colour that improves with washing and age. It has a Geographical Indication (GI) tag, and is used for mekhela chadors and other traditional Assamese dress.

Weaving

Sualkuchi, near Guwahati, is Assam's main silk-weaving town, where handlooms produce muga and pat cloth, and weavers' cooperatives keep the tradition alive.
